description: This file implements the core function `compute_assignment` for solving linear assignment problems using a shortest augmenting path algorithm, based on the work of Jonker and Volgenant. It includes algorithms for cost matrix reduction, transfer, and augmentation to find the optimal assignment between columns and rows.

methods.name: void compute_assignment(int column_count,int row_count,int * cost,int * column2row,int * row2column)
methods.description: Performs the assignment of columns to rows minimizing total cost using a shortest augmenting path algorithm.
